purpose: Attribute the failed Highway prototype before choosing its replacement. This is not another screen or qualification attempt.
hardware: Retained Spark spark-000280; queue behind other users and never interrupt them
hypotheses: Full-vocabulary scalar key packing or initialization dominates the extra cost
Highway's packed-key partial sort costs more than llama's small-k partial_sort
Tie detection frequently discards completed Highway work and invokes the original selector

method.worker: Exact immutable D executable from the failed screen; do not rebuild or relink it
method.inputs: Exact captured Spark logits and five frozen fixtures, verified against existing manifests
method.execution: Own-child GDB asynchronous interrupt/stack snapshots, 20 ms requested interval, at most 3000 snapshots and 180 seconds per case
method.workload: Production replay mode C, all five cases, 100 repetitions each; no decode qualification or performance comparison
method.calibration: First verify GDB MI sampling against an owned model-free child on JY; a profiler failure does not justify changing product code
method.evidence: Full debugger transcripts, sampled frame addresses, disassembly and binary/source/input/model hashes
method.interpretation: Sampling is intrusive and overhead is uncontrolled. Counts only identify executed hot paths; do not interpret debugger timings as unprofiled latency or qualifying speed.
method.tie_hypothesis: A stack in the original selector establishes fallback execution, not its frequency. If sampling cannot distinguish a hypothesis, add a separately frozen diagnostic rather than inventing attribution.

decision_map.packing: Design a bounded candidate prefilter that avoids packing the entire vocabulary, then freeze a new source revision and repeat affected correctness and fresh screens
decision_map.selection: Replace the unsuitable selection primitive only after inspecting its measured path; retain exact ordering and boundary-tie fallback
decision_map.fallback: Investigate safe early refusal or detection before expensive selection; never change tie semantics
decision_map.inconclusive: Retain evidence and report the unresolved mechanism; no favorable-repeat screen

recording_repair: Future timing jobs must carry durable in-run placement/process and thermal evidence. A post-run snapshot cannot stand in for missing observations. Archive every failed attempt and keep all existing numeric gates.
unchanged: Frozen B primary, R diagnostic, M6 and Spark separate; no Max, KV, deployment, agents or performance PR
